subject.title: fix(repair): close staged proof review gaps

question: Should this exact tree become the repair lane's production authority, proof-binding, durable-dispatch, credential-isolation, recovery, and final-mutation contract?
rationale: Source review and tests support the implementation, but they cannot decide whether the aggregate privileged security and availability behavior is the intended permanent production policy.

options.title: Approve the exact tree
options.body: Accept the reviewed production contract and move the draft toward merge once ordinary required checks and draft state are resolved.

options.title: Request a narrow contract change
options.body: Keep the draft open and identify the specific authority, isolation, queue, proof, recovery, or mutation invariant that must change.

options.title: Pause the rollout
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged if no repair-lane owner is prepared to accept the aggregate operational risk.

recommendation.title: Approve the exact tree
recommendation.body: Accept the reviewed production contract and move the draft toward merge once ordinary required checks and draft state are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The central workflow and trust-boundary history makes steipete the strongest available owner for this production-policy decision.
